title: Watchman, Blow the Gospel Trumpet
lyrics: [G]Watchman, blow the gospel trumpet, [C]Every [A]soul a warning [D]give;
[G]Whosoever hears the message [D]May repent, and, [A]turn and [D]live.
[C7]Blow the trumpet, trusty [G]watchman, [Em]Blow it [C]loud o'er land and [B]sea;
[G]God commissions, sound the mes[G7] - [C]sage! Every captive [G]may [D7]be [G]free.
Sound it loud o'er every hilltop,
Sound it in the hedge and highway,
Earth's dark spots where exiles roam;
Let it tell all things are ready,
Sound it for the heavy laden,
